SECTION

Company’s Vision, Mission, Objectives and Policies

VISION

To be a trusted partner for Global Maritime Logistics.

MISSION
® Recruit, develop, motivate, reward, and retain employees of high quality.
° Remain customer focused by providing value addition and exceeding expectations.
° Work towards ZERO HARM to people, environment and property.
° Create a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
° Conduct our business in a fair and transparent manner.

® Work towards reduction of permitted emissions.

ADOPTION OF OBJECTIVES

Company recognizes and adopts the objectives of the ISM Code which are to ensure
safety at sea, prevention of human injury or loss of life, avoidance of damage to the
environment, particularly the marine environment and property.

DESCRIPTION OF OBJECTIVES

Our aim is to build quality culture in our staff towards Safety, Health and Environmental
Protection.

OBJECTIVES
e To ensure safety at sea.
e To prevent human injury or loss of life and damage to property.
e To prevent damage to the environment, in particular the marine environment.
